items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Carpenter was there, the guy that wrote "Rosetta" with Earl, in Chicago.

ctx.x: Tenor saxophone player. It was really great. Well I lived in a house with the people that he lived in. He was something else. But I could never understand how those guys could rehearse so much. 'Cause I never rehearsed, Dan. I imagine that's the reason why I didn't become a classical pianist. 'Cause you know, you gotta rehearse quite a bit, you know, well you just have to devote maybe two, three hours a day to, you know, to rehearse. Charlie Carpenter was there, the guy that wrote "Rosetta" with Earl, in Chicago.
